stages.name: Rapid Evaluation
stages.notes: No daily loss limit. The limit stops trailing at $25,100, the starting balance plus $100. MFFU's EOD drawdown article (updated 2026-08-24) says "the Max EOD trailing locks in at $100 plus the initial starting balance", and MFFU's plan data on myfundedfutures.com (read 2026-09-29) sets a $25,100 lock on this evaluation. MFFU's evaluation-to-funded article (updated 2026-09-04) says the funded drawdown "will now lock at +$100", which reads as if only funded accounts lock; it never says the evaluation does not, so the plan data wins. MFFU's consistency article (updated 2026-09-25) says no single day's profit should exceed 50% "of your total evaluation profits made", and that going over means you "simply need to trade additional days"; its worked example divides the profit target instead. Modelled against total profit, which matches the rule text.

stages.name: Rapid Sim Funded

payoutPaths.name: Rapid daily payout
payoutPaths.notes: The buffer applies to every payout: "You must first build at least $1,100 in realized profits in the account before requesting any payout." Payouts every 24 hours; the first is available 24 hours after the first trade.

stages.notes: The drawdown switches to intraday trailing on the funded account and locks once the floor reaches the starting balance plus $100. MFFU's plan data moves the limit to the lock on the first payout. No daily loss limit or consistency rule. Rapid Live is not modelled: MFFU publishes no drawdown for it. The account moves live automatically at $10,000 of net profit in one session, with a live reserve of up to $5,000.

stages.name: Rapid EOD Sim Funded

payoutPaths.name: Rapid EOD payout
payoutPaths.notes: Each payout after the first needs $250 of net profit since the last payout and a $500 minimum request. The first payout needs a $1,100 buffer, so the balance must reach $26,100: "You must first build at least $1,100 in realized profits in the account before requesting your first payout." The buffer is for the first payout only, and the catalog cannot gate one payout differently from the rest. Payout paths are alternatives, so a separate first-payout path would show the later-payout rule as open from day one. The buffer is left out, which means the first payout shows as available before MFFU allows it.

stages.notes: The limit locks once the floor reaches the starting balance plus $100. MFFU's plan data moves the limit to the lock on the first payout. No daily loss limit or consistency rule.

stages.name: Pro Sim Funded

payoutPaths.name: Pro payout
payoutPaths.notes: Payouts every 14 calendar days from the first trade ("Request a payout every 14 calendar days from your first trade", payout policy overview, updated 2026-08-25); the catalog has no calendar-day gate, so this is not modelled. The overview says you "Must meet the buffer target before requesting a payout"; the older Pro page (updated 2026-06-30) says only the first withdrawal needs it. Modelled on every payout, per the newer page. A one-time withdrawal of up to 60% of profit, minimum $1,000, is allowed before the buffer clears; not modelled. $100,000 maximum per trader.

stages.notes: The limit stops trailing at $50,100 (MFFU's plan data on myfundedfutures.com, read 2026-09-29), and after the first payout it moves there and stays: "After first payout, MLL moves to $50,100 and remains static." No daily loss limit or consistency rule. Pro Live is not modelled: it is funded with a small static balance and a daily loss limit, with no published drawdown. Three payouts in a row trigger a review for live.

stages.name: Builder Evaluation
stages.notes: No consistency rule in the evaluation. The $600 soft daily loss limit pauses trading for the session. The limit locks once the floor reaches the starting balance plus $100: "The MLL locks permanently once it reaches $100 above the starting balance." The Builder 25K without a daily loss limit is now a legacy plan (help article 15862870) and is not modelled.

stages.name: Builder Sim Funded

payoutPaths.name: Builder payout
payoutPaths.notes: Needs 2 trading days per payout cycle. The buffer (MLL plus $100) must be cleared before any request, and the first payout needs $250 above it ("your account balance must reach at least $2,600" on the 50K), so the buffer is modelled as balance kept back. Later payouts need $250 of net profit since the last one. The consistency rule is measured on the current payout cycle and "resets after each approved payout." Up to 5 sim payouts; the first 48 hours after the first trade.
